property.name: abstractName
property.description: The name of the abstract product.

property.name: brand
property.description: Brand of the product, the value of its brand attribute; null when it has none.

property.name: selectedVariantAttributes
property.description: The super attributes of the concrete product the view shows, attribute key to value, ordered by attribute key as strings, e.g. {"color": "Red", "storage_capacity": "64 GB"}; empty without a concrete product.

property.name: categoryPath
property.description: The category names of the product, top level first, without the root category.

property.name: selectedVariantAttributes
property.description: The super attributes of the concrete product, attribute key to value, ordered by attribute key as strings, e.g. {"color": "Red", "storage_capacity": "64 GB"}; set when the item is added to the cart, and from the order item's super attributes when an order is read.
